title: Nondiscrimination.
bodyText: A licensee shall not unfairly discriminate against any consumer or customer because that consumer or customer has opted out from the disclosure of nonpublic personal financial information under this article.
bodyHtml: [§431:3A-502]  Nondiscrimination.  A licensee shall not unfairly discriminate against any consumer or customer because that consumer or customer has opted out from the disclosure of nonpublic personal financial information under this article. [L 2001, c 220, pt of §1]
